create_chatbox_component: create a Chatbox component with ChatBoxConfig to build a Dash chat UI with callbacks
register_chatbox_callbacks: register Dash callbacks on a Chatbox instance to handle user input and assistant responses
encode_image_to_base64: encode an image file at a given path to a base64 string for embedding in HTML
replace_instance_with_image: replace instance id references in text with base64 encoded images from disk
create_chat_textbox: create a styled Dash chat textbox card for user or assistant messages with optional images
